gaps.finding: Nova exposes Delta-star through a preconstructed equilibrium solve mesh, but has no public raw rectilinear label-map helper. The spike uses a second-order NumPy stencil and does not patch Nova.

Nova owns the forward Grad-Shafranov convention but has no inverse per-surface R-squared separation kernel for recovering p-prime and FF-prime from a current map. The spike uses per-annulus least squares and does not patch Nova.

Nova's transport geometry can assemble the exact toroidal-flux coordinate when profile coefficients and boundary toroidal field are known. The challenge labels omit both, so the banked rho-hat is an explicitly named geometric proxy proportional to the integral of inverse-R-squared times dV/dpsi; it is not exact toroidal flux.

A Nova free-boundary re-solve needs machine conductor geometry, currents, boundary toroidal field and profile parameterization beyond the label-only extraction inputs. No re-solve is claimed by this worker node.
